message:
How it reads now:
Openings sheet
Role (text, required), Team (Engineering, Growth, Customer or Operations), Hiring manager (person), Salary band (money range), Opens on (date).
Steps: Draft → Open → Filled or Closed.

Candidates sheet
Name (text, required), Opening (one row from Openings), Source (Referral, Inbound or Agency), Referred by (person), CV (file), Offer (money), Offer approval (Approved or Declined), Start date (date).
The form: Candidate (Name, Opening, Source, Referred by and CV), Offer (Offer, Offer approval and Start date). Asked when creating: Name.
Steps: Applied → Screen → Interview → Offer → Hired or Rejected.

Interviews sheet
Candidate (one row from Candidates, required), Interviewer (person), When (date and time), Score (1 to 4), Notes (long text).

Referrals sheet
Name (text, required).

Agencies sheet
Name (text, required).

Job boards sheet
Name (text, required).

What happens by itself
An offer above the role’s salary band waits on Wade to approve it.
An offer within the band waits on the hiring manager to send it.
Once Wade approves an offer, it waits on the hiring manager to send it.
When a candidate is Hired, start their onboarding plan with name, start date and manager.
When a candidate is Hired, their opening moves to Filled.
When a candidate moves to Interview, add three interviews and give each interviewer a scorecard task.
On the day of an interview, if it has no score yet, it waits on the interviewer for their scorecard.

Who can see and do what
Wade Wilson sees every role, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Hiring managers see their own roles and can add, edit and move them.
Priya Nair, Maya Chen, Omar Ali, Kim Tran and Ana Ruiz see every role.
Priya Nair, Maya Chen, Omar Ali, Kim Tran and Ana Ruiz see their own candidates and can add them.
Interviewers see their own interviews and can edit them.
Everyone else sees nothing.

Connections
People fills Hiring manager.
People fills Referred by.
People fills Interviewer.
At Hired, start a plan in Onboarding.

Coming soon
Connections to other software

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Add an Offers sheet
